response.justification: Bogdan is a solid, versatile full-stack/software craftsman with broad experience across web, embedded, and infrastructure, but he falls well short of the profile required for a Director-level Principal Engineer role focused on AI strategy. He has roughly 14-15 years of experience (close on tenure), but lacks a Master's/PhD in AI, no demonstrated recognized AI expertise or AI-driven products/platforms, no cloud/AI strategy or customer-advisory experience, and no evidence of entrepreneurial/startup leadership within a larger org. His only AI-adjacent exposure is recent and shallow (MCP tooling, agentic workflows since April 2025).
strengths: Long, diverse engineering career spanning web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure
Demonstrated technical depth (low-latency systems, DLang, TDD/CI practices, open-source projects)
Experience mentoring and teaching (workshops, talks, dojos) showing ability to inspire others
concerns: No advanced degree or specialized background in AI/ML
No track record of building or leading recognized AI products/platforms
No experience in cloud/AI strategy, customer advisory, or director-level scope

key_factors.factor: Lack of AI expertise/product track record
No strategic/customer-facing or director-level leadership experience
Strong general engineering breadth and craftsmanship
